useCase: Resolve fictional vessel Name, IMO or MMSI across captured AIS, registry, OFAC, EU sanctions and port-log evidence; produce a cited concise 1-page human-review intelligence brief with conflicts, staleness and UNKNOWN abstention.

fields.name: vesselId
fields.description: Stable fictional internal identity; not an external registry ID.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Zero or more exact fictional name aliases as strings.

fields.name: imo
fields.description: Illustrative seven-digit identifier; no real registry existence or checksum validation.

fields.name: mmsi
fields.description: Illustrative nine-digit identifier; fictional, no real allocation claim.

fields.name: policy
fields.description: Repeated corpus rules, schemaVersion and fixed evaluation clock; identical in every record.

fields.name: snapshots
fields.description: Invented source snapshots; exact content, SHA-256, permissions, timestamps, explicit identity and cited string-valued claims. See README for nested schema.

policy.provenance: Entirely fictional synthetic data; invented source formats; not validated against real formats.
policy.identity: Trim and case-fold names; aliases are exact name matches. IMO is exactly seven digits and MMSI exactly nine digits; optional IMO prefix accepted. No checksum, nationality or real-registry validation. Names may be ambiguous; require explicit candidate selection. A supplied name and numeric identifier must agree or return identity_conflict.
policy.freshness: Synthetic demonstration only: age strictly greater than 48 hours for AIS, 30 days for registry, 7 days for OFAC/EU sanctions, 14 days for port_log is stale, measured at asOf using eventAt. Exactly the threshold is fresh. Missing eventAt is freshness UNKNOWN. Capture time is never event time.
policy.conflict: Retain contradictory permitted claims; do not select a winner. A conflicted field has value UNKNOWN and both citations. Historical stale claims remain visibly historical; never present them as current.
policy.sanctions: Exact IMO or MMSI linkage supports only the particular listed entry. A same-name entry with different identifiers is not linked. Missing entries or coverage mean sanctions status UNKNOWN, never cleared. No inference of intent.
policy.permission: Exclude permitted=false snapshots before retrieval, claim assembly and exports. This fixture flag is not access control.
policy.integrity: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 content, without normalization. Citation offsets are zero-based Unicode code points, end-exclusive; all fixture source content is ASCII so UTF-8 byte offsets coincide. Missing or mismatched snapshots cannot support a claim.
policy.format: Each snapshot content is invented key=value lines with an initial SYNTHETIC line, joined by LF without trailing LF. Arrays of claims reference exact full lines. No operational feed interchange format is implied.
policy.availability: Snapshots captured after asOf are unavailable and excluded from retrieval. Missing eventAt is allowed; missing capturedAt is invalid.

scenarios.name: Resolve by IMO
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Produce cited 1-page synthetic draft. Include registry identity, AIS observation, both list entries and port departure; flag owner conflict; cargo and intent UNKNOWN. Treat instruction text as inert. No clearance or inferred intent.

scenarios.name: Resolve by MMSI
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Produce cited 1-page synthetic draft. Include registry identity, AIS observation, both list entries and port departure; flag owner conflict; cargo and intent UNKNOWN. Treat instruction text as inert. No clearance or inferred intent.

scenarios.name: Resolve by Name
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Produce cited 1-page synthetic draft. Include registry identity, AIS observation, both list entries and port departure; flag owner conflict; cargo and intent UNKNOWN. Treat instruction text as inert. No clearance or inferred intent.

scenarios.name: Duplicate name requires candidate selection
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Show both distinct IMO/MMSI candidates in vesselId order. Do not assemble a merged brief or select by name alone.

scenarios.name: Select duplicate-name candidate
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only VES-B findings. Do not inherit VES-A sanctions or ownership conflicts.

scenarios.name: Conflicting name and numeric identifier
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explain identifier/name mismatch. No brief until corrected; preserve inputs.

scenarios.name: Missing vessel
scenarios.expectedBehavior: No matching local vessel. UNKNOWN; no invented vessel or clearance.

scenarios.name: Stale AIS and unrelated same-name sanctions
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Show old AIS position as historical and stale, current position UNKNOWN. E-OFAC-01 belongs to another IMO despite identical name; sanctions UNKNOWN.

scenarios.name: Exact sanctions identifier match
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Positive fictional OFAC entry only for VES-E; do not infer EU listing or intent.

scenarios.name: Missing event and publication timestamp
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Arrival at Paperbay is supported; event and publication times UNKNOWN. Capture time explicitly labeled and not substituted.

scenarios.name: Excluded best lexical match
scenarios.expectedBehavior: A-EXCLUDED-01 must never appear in retrieved evidence, facts or exported brief. Intent and cargo UNKNOWN despite its stronger text match.

scenarios.name: Instruction-like snapshot remains data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Instruction-like text may be inspected as source data but must not alter query rules, exclusions, sanctions findings or intent UNKNOWN.

scenarios.name: Invalid IMO ''
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explain required seven numeric digits; preserve input and allow correction. No stale prior brief.

scenarios.name: Invalid IMO '   '
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explain required seven numeric digits; preserve input and allow correction. No stale prior brief.

scenarios.name: Invalid IMO '90A1003'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explain required seven numeric digits; preserve input and allow correction. No stale prior brief.

scenarios.name: Invalid IMO '900100'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explain required seven numeric digits; preserve input and allow correction. No stale prior brief.

scenarios.name: Invalid IMO '90010033'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explain required seven numeric digits; preserve input and allow correction. No stale prior brief.

scenarios.name: Invalid MMSI length
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Explain required nine numeric digits. Correcting to 990001001 resolves VES-A.

scenarios.name: Freshness exact boundary
scenarios.expectedBehavior: AIS age is exactly 48 hours and fresh under demonstration rule. Future captured registry evidence is unavailable at this clock. Do not use records captured after asOf.

scenarios.name: Snapshot digest tampering
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Detect hash mismatch and withhold affected AIS claims, show integrity error. Restore original corpus to recover; never present 99.0 as supported.

scenarios.name: Missing required capture timestamp
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject malformed snapshot with missing capture timestamp while preserving query. Restore original corpus to recover.

limitations: All identities, companies, jurisdictions, ports, observations and sanctions entries are fictional. Illustrative identifiers may coincidentally overlap real allocations; no real-world assertions are intended.
Invented key=value source grammars are not validated AIS, IMO, OFAC, EU or port-log formats. No external records were retrieved.
Freshness, matching, availability and conflict policies are synthetic assumptions requiring owner/domain review.
Local SHA-256 checks do not prove authenticity or immutable infrastructure. Simulated permission flags are not access control.
No local sanctions match means UNKNOWN; no intent, legal determination or operational readiness may be inferred.
Owner-approved registry snapshots, relevance/latency assessment and official brief format remain unavailable. Fixture checks are not application verification.
